operators.name: embedding_forward
semantics: Performs embedding lookup: output[i,j,k] = weight[indices[i,j], k] for all i,j,k
Indices are expected to be within [0, num_embeddings-1], no out-of-bound check (reference nn.Embedding has no check in eval mode)
No gradient computation in inference; output is a fresh tensor

operators.name: clamp_min_forward
semantics: Computes element-wise maximum of input and min_value: output = max(input, min_value)
If min_value is not provided, defaults to 0.0 as in reference torch.clamp_min default
Output has same shape, dtype, device as input
Input x is int64 tensor on CPU with shape [8192,256]; must be moved to CUDA before custom kernel
Embedding lookup: output shape [8192,256,64], dtype float32, device cuda
Output values are selected from embedding weight by indices
Clamp minimum: output = max(x, 0.0) since self.min_value=0.0 for this task
Output shape [8192,256,64], dtype float32, device cuda
This is the final return value
